races.name: CopyBet Pay First Past The Post Mares' Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)

runners_data.name: Auntie Maggie
runners_data.note: Front runner with proven 2m handicap form who may have needed her recent comeback run after 26 days off
runners_data.comment: Three hurdle wins; showed some aptitude for fences when 18l third at Uttoxeter in October
runners_data.spotlight: Won three handicap hurdles within the space of four runs last year (all at 2m on goodish ground) and the last of those was off this mark; may have needed the run last time after a break and showed some aptitude for fences when an 18l third at Uttoxeter in October.

runners_data.name: Feet On The Ground
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making chase debut with pointing background that should benefit from the strong pace
runners_data.comment: Modest hurdler but a pointing background bodes well for this switch to fences
runners_data.spotlight: Ultimately disappointing over hurdles (0-12) but she has some competitive form off this sort of mark and a pointing background bodes well for this switch to fences.

runners_data.name: Fox Wallace
runners_data.note: Front runner whose form has collapsed badly, with cheekpieces quickly removed after latest failure
runners_data.comment: Has lost her way badly since her win/place form over fences last summer
runners_data.spotlight: Has lost her way badly since her win/place form over fences last summer; cheekpieces tried last time are swiftly removed; couldn't trust.

runners_data.name: Caterpillar Girl
runners_data.note: Promising front runner making only her second chase start after falling on debut at Warwick
runners_data.comment: Long way to go when falling at Warwick (chase debut) but this looks even weaker
runners_data.spotlight: Won a bumper but beaten between 23l and 46l over hurdles (2m); 28-1 for last month's chase debut at Warwick (2m4f, good) where she was still in touch when falling five out; there was still a long way to go but this looks an even weaker race.

runners_data.name: Beorma
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making chase debut but showing concerning finishing kick issues in recent hurdle runs
runners_data.comment: hardly a solid option, though this is her chase debut and a tongue-tie is added.
runners_data.spotlight: No show at all in two 2m handicap hurdles following 15 months out, including returned to good ground latest; hardly a solid option, though this is her chase debut and a tongue-tie is added.

races.paceDynamic: Caterpillar Girl, Auntie Maggie, and Fox Wallace will engage from the start, creating a strong gallop throughout this 2m4f test. With three confirmed front runners in a five-horse field, there's nowhere to hide and the pace will be searching from flag to finish. The sustained tempo will stretch the field early and test stamina reserves over the final half-mile. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can conserve energy early and finish with late momentum.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners go too hard early and weaken
scenarios.body: The strong gallop plays into the hands of Feet On The Ground and Beorma who can sit off the pace and pick up the pieces. Their chase experience and tactical positioning becomes crucial as the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Auntie Maggie Controls Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Auntie Maggie gets first run on her rivals from an ideal position
scenarios.body: Her proven stamina at this trip and class advantage allows her to dictate terms and kick clear when it matters. The other front runners either go too early or can't match her sustained effort.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Caterpillar Girl Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the young mare learns from her Warwick fall and travels sweetly
scenarios.body: Her class from bumper form translates to fences with Jonathan Burke keeping her balanced throughout. The strong pace sets up perfectly for her to strike late and justify the step up in trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Fox Wallace Revival
scenarios.trigger: If the cheekpiece removal sparks improvement and she finds her old form
scenarios.body: She gets competitive again off her reduced mark with the strong pace suiting her front-running style. Her previous fence form suggests she can handle this company when right.

watchPoints.text: Fox Wallace's early positioning could be erratic given her poor recent form and equipment changes
Caterpillar Girl's jumping under pressure after her Warwick fall when still in contention
Beorma's finishing kick given her tendency to fade late in recent starts
The pace battle between three front runners could set up a tactical mess early
Feet On The Ground's jumping technique on chase debut after disappointing hurdle career

races.name: PJ Nicholls KGM Korea Genuinely Made Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Sunray Shadow
runners_data.note: Hold-up merchant making chase debut off hurdles success just 9 days ago, needs pace to aim at but fresh from quick turnaround
runners_data.spotlight: Hasn't had a lot of racing and he makes his chase debut off the same mark he defied fairly comfortably in a 3m1f handicap hurdle last week at Huntingdon (good to firm); major claims if he takes to his new discipline.

runners_data.name: Samuel Spade
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 131-day break with poor recent hurdles form, better on good ground but lacks race fitness
runners_data.comment: Quiet last season but too well handicapped to dismiss on chasing debut
runners_data.spotlight: Last season's light campaign over hurdles did not go well (tried in cheekpieces latterly) but he shouldn't mind getting back on drier ground and is too well handicapped to dismiss on chasing debut.

runners_data.name: Mt Fugi Park
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who made all at Market Rasen 44 days ago, will dictate pace but up 4lb in first-time blinkers
runners_data.comment: Up 4lb but the blinkers have made a difference and should remain competitive
runners_data.spotlight: Seemed to be running well in first-time blinkers before falling at Carlisle and he then made all the running under Gina Andrews at Market Rasen (3m, good); up 4lb but the blinkers have made a difference and should remain competitive.

runners_data.name: Court In A Storm
runners_data.note: Good ground specialist with hold-up style, three-time winner who should improve for switch to chasing from hurdles
runners_data.comment: Useful hurdler who may well improve for going chasing, as did his useful dam
runners_data.spotlight: Confined to good ground for all eight races; a bumper and two-time novice hurdle winner who has been running well in staying handicap hurdles and he may well improve for going chasing, as did his useful dam.

runners_data.name: Masterdream
runners_data.note: Course and distance winner last season but finished last twice recently, prominent runner whose confidence needs rebuilding
runners_data.comment: Capable chaser off this mark but he's finished a remote last in his final two chase starts
runners_data.spotlight: Won three handicap chases last season (one over C&D on good) and back on his last winning mark; however, he's finished a remote last in his final two chase starts.

runners_data.name: Impatient
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner off 93-day break, won well at Huntingdon in December but heavy defeat last time out concerning
runners_data.comment: In good form until heavy defeat last time; a break could have done him good
runners_data.spotlight: Won in fine style at Huntingdon (2m7f, good to soft) in December and went close at Market Rasen (3m, soft) next time; has suffered a heavy defeat since then but a break could have done him good.

runners_data.name: Zacony Rebel
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran who thrives at Ludlow with 3-5 record there, won twice recently including 18 days ago from out of weights
runners_data.comment: Thriving 11yo who has gone back-to-back at Ludlow and he's won here before
runners_data.spotlight: Won from well out of the weights at Ludlow and off only 3lb higher he followed up at the expense of three rivals (3m, good), taking his record there to 3-5; has another 6lb rise to contend with but has won here and has to be taken seriously.

races.paceDynamic: Mt Fugi Park will take them along at his preferred prominent pace with Masterdream and Impatient likely tracking just behind him in the early stages. With only one natural front runner and several hold-up horses (Sunray Shadow, Samuel Spade, Court In A Storm, Zacony Rebel), the pace should be manageable rather than frenetic. The sustained nature of this 2m7f test means the pace will gradually build through the middle sections before a proper test of stamina in the final half-mile. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace who can position handy and kick when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Mt Fugi Park dictates an even tempo without serious pressure through the first two miles
scenarios.body: The measured gallop plays perfectly into the hands of those positioned close to the pace, allowing them to conserve energy for a sustained drive from three out. Mt Fugi Park and Masterdream can utilise their prominent styles while Impatient has the tactical pace to strike from close range.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Get Target
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too hard early or the pace becomes stop-start through the middle sections
scenarios.body: Sunray Shadow and Court In A Storm benefit from a strongly-run race that sets up perfectly for their patient tactics, sweeping past tiring leaders in the final furlong. Their fresh legs from tracking the pace prove decisive as the early leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Masterdream Redemption
scenarios.trigger: If Masterdream shows his old sparkle and overcomes recent poor form with aggressive tactics
scenarios.body: The nine-year-old uses his course and distance winning experience to position perfectly behind Mt Fugi Park before taking over smoothly approaching the final fence. His class on his day proves too much for this field despite recent disappointing efforts.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the front runners go far too fast early and come back to the field dramatically
scenarios.body: The early pace setters Mt Fugi Park and Masterdream burn out completely, leaving the race to Samuel Spade and Zacony Rebel who have been patiently tracking from the rear. Their fresh finishing kicks prove unstoppable as the field bunches entering the straight.

watchPoints.text: Mt Fugi Park could steal this if allowed his own way in front without pressure through the early stages
Masterdream's confidence levels after two poor runs - any early enthusiasm suggests he's back to his best
Sunray Shadow's jumping on chase debut particularly at the first few fences as he adjusts to the bigger obstacles
Samuel Spade's fitness levels after 131 days off and whether he can recapture his better form from previous seasons
The pace through the first mile - if too strong it will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses to sweep past late

races.name: CopyBet Daily Profit Boost Novices' Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: So Proud

runners_data.spotlight: Bought for £100,000 after winning a Haydock bumper for Don Cantillon; beaten a shade over 20l in two maiden hurdles (good to soft/good) but disappointing if he can't raise his game sooner or later.

runners_data.name: King's Scholar

runners_data.comment: Useful on the Flat and won well at Southwell; clear claims under a penalty

runners_data.name: Arbitration
runners_data.note: Front-runner with hood added to aid settling, 15 days since last run gives him fitness edge
runners_data.comment: Flat winner; second on hurdle debut despite pulling hard; now hooded

runners_data.name: Nannymooresbridge
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but lacks any worthwhile form evidence in four starts over obstacles
runners_data.comment: No worthwhile form in two bumpers and as many runs over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: No worthwhile form in two bumpers and as many runs over hurdles.

runners_data.name: Delta Legend
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but pulled up on hurdle debut at 100-1 and shows regression on recent form
runners_data.comment: Regressive on the Flat and 100-1 when pulled up on his recent hurdle debut
runners_data.spotlight: Raced mainly on AW, winning twice in 2024 then eventually regressing; 100-1 when pulled up on his recent hurdle debut.

runners_data.name: Magna Patch
runners_data.note: Prominent style fits race shape but warning sign of fading in finish and 41 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Only a smidgen of promise in three runs over hurdles and handicaps will be more like it
runners_data.spotlight: Only a smidgen of promise in three runs over hurdles and handicaps will be more like it.

races.paceDynamic: Arbitration will set a sustainable pace from the front with no other confirmed leaders in this small field. So Proud and the prominent trio of King's Scholar, Nannymooresbridge, Delta Legend and Magna Patch will track behind in a compact group. The lack of early pace pressure means Arbitration can dictate throughout and potentially steal a march turning for home. This tactical setup strongly favours the front-runner and prominent racers who can stay close to the pace, with hold-up horse King's Scholar facing the toughest task from the rear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Arbitration gets an easy lead and maintains a strong gallop
scenarios.body: The hood addition helps him settle and he can quicken clear before the field organises a challenge. King's Scholar has too much ground to make up from his hold-up style.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If So Proud and the prominent runners close the gap turning in
scenarios.body: A sustained drive develops between the pace-tracking horses with superior class telling. Arbitration may weaken after setting the fractions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Rises Late
scenarios.trigger: If King's Scholar gets a clear run and finds his best form
scenarios.body: His superior flat form and recent Ludlow encouragement sees him sweep past the pace-setters despite the tactical disadvantage. The moderate pace actually helps his finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Arbitration goes too slow and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse can win from the tight pack. Form becomes less reliable in a muddling contest.

watchPoints.text: Arbitration's early fractions - if he goes too fast or too slow it completely changes the race dynamic
King's Scholar's position turning in - needs to be closer than usual given the lack of pace
So Proud's jump at the second last - his prominent position makes him the main pace threat to Arbitration
Any pulling or settling issues in the first half mile given the hood on Arbitration and pace concerns
The pace through halfway - this small field could easily string out or bunch up depending on Arbitration's tactics

races.paceDynamic: Jubertilee will likely dictate from the front with no obvious pressure from early pace angles, allowing him to bowl along at a sustainable gallop over this extended trip. The prominent runners Artiste d'Ainay, Whenthemusicstops, Edna E Mode, and Ultra Viers should track within striking distance but none are aggressive early types. This creates a tactical race where the pace could be moderate early before quickening from 3 out, with plenty of horses held up for late challenges including Mexican Stan, Son Of Tyran, Saint Vic and Brionywells. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and late finishers who can produce sustained runs from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Jubertilee sets only moderate fractions and the race develops into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The patient tactics allow closers to unleash telling runs in the final half-mile when the early pace horses weaken. Mexican Stan and Son Of Tyran are perfectly positioned to strike late having both won recently when held up over similar trips.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front group stays strong
scenarios.trigger: If Jubertlee maintains a solid tempo throughout and the prominent horses stay competitive
scenarios.body: Artiste d'Ainay and Whenthemusicstops can sustain their efforts better than the field expects. The pace becomes honest enough to blunt the finishing kicks of the hold-up brigade while rewarding those who tracked the leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Jubertilee leads throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the leader faces no serious challenge and can dictate terms completely
scenarios.body: His point-to-point background and stamina reserves allow him to control the race from pillar to post. The lack of early pressure means he conserves energy for a sustained kick that the field cannot match despite his modest recent form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop becomes crawling and turns into a pure sprint
scenarios.body: The tactical affair suits horses with the highest cruising speed rather than stamina. Son Of Tyran's class edge and Mexican Stan's recent confidence boost become decisive factors in a dash from the final hurdle.

watchPoints.text: Son Of Tyran and Mexican Stan both fade in the finish according to their profiles, so watch if they're still travelling strongly turning for home
Jubertilee has modest recent form despite his placings, so monitor if he's actually able to build a meaningful lead
Artiste d'Ainay weakened late at Hexham over this trip, so watch his stamina reserves in the final half-mile
Whenthemusicstops was a weak 16-1 chance on handicap debut, so check market support for any confidence
Saint Vic is only second run back from a lengthy break, so improvement expected but watch for signs of ring-rustiness

races.paceDynamic: Siam Park will dictate this race as the sole confirmed front-runner, likely setting a sustainable tempo without early pressure given the hold-up heavy field composition. The remaining six runners - Scintillante, Fidendum, Get The Value, Charging Thunder, Crown Of India all being hold-up merchants with only Cawthorne Banker showing any prominent tendencies - will settle in behind creating a bunched field. This creates a tactical race where the front-runner can control the fractions and kick when ready. The shape heavily favours Siam Park's lead tactics and any horse capable of tracking him early, as the hold-up brigade will face a wall of horses in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Siam Park Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Siam Park sets steady fractions and isn't pressured early.
scenarios.body: He can dictate when to quicken and the hold-up horses face a wall of traffic behind him. His front-running style becomes a major tactical advantage in this field composition.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the field bunches up.
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get a clear run through and superior class tells in a sprint finish. Scintillante's recent Warwick fourth suggests returning form could be decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fidendum Makes All
scenarios.trigger: If Fidendum jumps prominently and challenges Siam Park for the lead.
scenarios.body: The pace lifts and it becomes a test of stamina where Fidendum's recent Market Rasen win shows he has the engine. Two pace-setters could set it up for hold-up horses though.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a cavalry charge.
scenarios.body: Crown Of India or Get The Value could sneak through at big odds when the favourites don't get clear runs. The 14lb difference between top and bottom weight becomes significant in a sprint.

watchPoints.text: Siam Park could get an uncontested lead and prove impossible to peg back with this tactical advantage
Fidendum's tendency to run out means he's unreliable despite his Market Rasen win last time
Charging Thunder returning after 180 days could need the run despite his proven hurdle ability
Scintillante's position turning in will be crucial given his hold-up style in this tactical race
The pace early on determines everything - if it's too slow the hold-up horses get their chance

races.paceDynamic: Scottish Dancer will likely set the pace from the front with minimal early pressure, as most runners prefer to sit off the pace. Churchman and Mancero could track in behind but both can settle, leaving Scottish Dancer to dictate terms through the early stages. The sustained gallop over 2m4f will test stamina reserves, with the real action beginning from three out as the hold-up horses begin their challenges. This pace setup strongly favours the prominent racers and those with tactical speed, as they can position close enough to strike without getting caught behind a wall of horses in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Scottish Dancer gets an uncontested lead and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to conserve energy for a strong finish, making it difficult for closers to peg back. Prominent racers can track the pace and have every chance to challenge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow early and quickens dramatically late
scenarios.body: The stamina-laden finish becomes a sprint from the final flight, suiting horses with a turn of foot. Skelton's guidance gives Playful Fox the tactical edge in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Scottish Dancer sets steady pace but fades from two out
scenarios.body: The race sets up perfectly for horses positioned in second or third to inherit the lead. Churchman's recent form in similar trips makes him the prime beneficiary.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Scottish Dancer goes too slow and field bunches up turning in
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy cavalry charge with little between them at the last. Light weights and in-form horses get first run in a blanket finish.
